purpose: Need prompt -> expected rUv package (or none). The exit gate for the proactive package recommender (ADR-0093). Written BEFORE the matcher was tuned; frozen thereafter. Thresholds may be tuned on split=dev only; split=heldout is reported separately and is the number that judges the feature.
privacy: Every prompt is newly written in the owner's casual, dictated style. None is copied from a session transcript, issue, or private repository.
grounding: Each expected id is a package card derived from a public manifest passage in the Brain's own corpus (scripts/package-cards.mjs); the card's `source` field cites the passage path. @ruvector/typesafe, @ruvector/router, @ruvector/tiny-dancer were additionally confirmed with search_ruvnet on 2026-10-01 (ruvector/npm/packages/typesafe/package.json, ruvector/npm/packages/router/package.json, ruvector/npm/packages/tiny-dancer/package.json); ruvector-hybrid/-maxsim/-query-cache/-gnn-rerank from their crates/<name>/Cargo.toml passages.
scoring: A positive (category design|diagnosis) passes when the recommender fires AND its package is in `accept` (or its card's store is in `acceptStores`). A negative (category off-topic|no-fit) passes when it stays silent. Precision = correct firings / all firings.
